title: Planning a removed or renamed command flag puts every file that prints or documents it in the item's touches
goal: When an item's goal removes or renames a backlog.py or kbgit.py flag, planning finds every tracked file that prints or documents the flag (advice strings in _tools/bl_*.py, usage text, skills, agents, kb/_self docs), for example with backlog.py referrers taking a flag, and puts each in the item's touches before the start. Answers the SP-ktup3cha retrospective: ST-juoeq36g's touches lacked bl_check.py, bl_plan.py, bl_land.py and backlog.py, whose messages named set --add, and the orchestrator widened them by hand before the claim.
